# Bona (بونا)

> Bona is a private luxury real estate boutique in Jeddah, representing a curated portfolio of villas, penthouses, waterfront residences and off-market homes across Saudi Arabia and select international destinations.

Bona is a REGA-licensed real estate brokerage (FAL licence 1100313556) based in Al Rawdah District, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, founded in 2026 by Abdulaziz Zidan (Founder & Principal). Bilingual site: English at https://bona-real-estate.com/ and Arabic at https://bona-real-estate.com/ar/. Enquiries are handled on WhatsApp +966 59 329 6933 (https://wa.me/966593296933). Prices shown are the seller's asking prices — Bona never publishes valuations or automated estimates.

Markets: Jeddah, Riyadh, Dubai, Côte d'Azur, Costa del Sol, Oman.
Services: buying, selling, letting, off-plan and international acquisitions, off-market introductions.
Hours: Sunday – Thursday, 10:00 – 19:00 (Asia/Riyadh).
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bona.com.sa/
